4839.title: Retry scheduling omits temporary gateway failures
4839.rootCauseOneLine: Retry policy rejects gateway failure classifications and lacks a gateway retry deadline in its failure input.
4839.proposedFix: Carry typed gateway retry origin/deadline to the server policy, preserve authentication rejection, and use bounded retry scheduling.
4839.caveats: Classifier-to-enabled-plugin reproduction, not a real outage reenactment. The plugin was reportedly disabled during the production incidents. Test and output are inline; raw evidence remains private.
